name: Jagdish Panigrahi
headline: Full-Stack & Cloud Developer · AI Builder · Automation
summary: Self-taught developer building complete platforms from idea to deployment. Built and maintain **Rether**, a Vercel-style serverless hosting platform with **300+ API routes**; rapidly rebuild production-grade products, automate workflows with payments, bots and AI, and am designing a custom programming language.

projects.title: Rether
projects.subtitle: Vercel-alternative cloud hosting platform (formerly QORB) · Builder & maintainer
projects.stack: Node.js · Express · Vercel Serverless · Turso/libSQL · REST API (300+ routes)
bullets: A **mini cloud with a serverless backend** that deploys users' sites to their own Vercel accounts through a **pluggable deploy engine**: preview deploys and promote, deploy hooks, per-environment env vars, runtime logs and an activity log.
**Custom-domain verification** (TXT + routing), a **public status page**, and notifications over Telegram, email, Discord, Slack and webhooks.
**Plan billing with UPI payments** and auto-expiry/auto-restart of projects; **₹1 UPI account verification** with anti-abuse checks.
**Multi-chain crypto checkout** (USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, SOL, TRX across 13 coin + network combos) in progress.
**Admin panel** with monitoring, automation rules and a cron kill-switch; an **AI website/app builder** inside the platform; an **Android app**.
A **34-page docs site** and a news/blog with an admin editor.
Own **MongoDB-style query layer on libSQL** and **AES-256-GCM** field encryption with key rotation.
